notes.title: STLD NightMist Final UPDATE & KICKSTARTER Promo
notes.notes:
Oh man, it's been a minute. Things have been strange lately, not to mention extremely busy. Covid exists now, so that sucks. I think I'd prefer the zombie apocalypse. 

There have been [b]MASSIVE[/b] updates made to the project to finally put it on it's own two feet, I'm just going to bullet point things out since you guys seem to prefer that method. There's been so many tweaks, additions, and straight up changes to the game I'd never be able to cover each of them, but I'll be trying to hit on all the big ones. 

Also if you're interested [b]in a future for STLD[/b] as a series please continue reading.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/149bf5c686bde4c8d8d9e90d92d357e4b1e56fe9.png[/img]

[h2]✵ Entirely Updated Rez and New Interface !
[/h2]
It's all been resized and redesigned toward a much more cohesive aesthetic that's easier to read/comprehend, whether you're just investigating or in the middle of some intense combat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/614b3f4a43260992126c4d958f34b5f49370e434.png[/img]

______________________________________________________________



[h2]✵ The Inquisitor is here![/h2]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/vxIlyjMdF5xd78eyfz/giphy.gif[/img]
The Boss is finally here and [b]he wants a piece of you.[/b]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/noZLg4DTOvrcHxGyl1/giphy.gif[/img]
His relentless attacks are something of a polar opposite to the way the other Cultists before him operate. 
His health can be monitored at the bottom, if you're playing on HARDCORE be ready for a real fight.

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/tKN024AHVEgLgBPGZn/giphy.gif[/img]
Keep in mind you will have to deal with the other enemies as you duel with the Inquisitor!

The Inquisitors spells [b] can be reflected back [/b] onto him if you have discovered the [b]Magic Charm artifact.[/b] 

Which brings me to the next change:

______________________________________________________________



[h2]✵ ARTIFACTS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/60ea9da7e207a6c5905e6ebf075318e2658a9548.png[/img]
You discover Artifacts by completing different challenges within the game. You may only equip 2 at a time so it's up to you to pick the best combinations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/4fcedd1fc8c6a8de377fe20926e0b791073a85e0.png[/img]
There will be 5 Artifacts per Episode, if you discover them here you can bring them into other Episodes in the future!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/030/992/495/d3c08514ee474183431c2ccb1cc93ab8_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1602624282&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=8211ad5a4f0a6efe9464f6bf4eb2f2f0[/img]
Here the player chose the Moonshine Flask and the Magic Charm as their [b]Artifacts [/b]for the round. 

______________________________________________________________



[h2]✵ BOSS WEAPON[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8BS1Elc.gif[/img]
If you manage to kill the boss you can take his sword [b]Night Mist[/b] .

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/1f1db06ca5b5dbcd06db5b1aced023afab04eb37.png[/img]
Night Mist has a VERY high critical chance and 2 special attacks!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/qQ58RXNxEXrWxYDIhN/giphy.gif[/img]
Holding Sprint while Attacking will create [b]lighting[/b] at the cost of 1 Special Orb.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/hCSBIpOzoYvuqdBCkg/giphy.gif[/img]
If you *[i]throw[/i] the weapon with a full special you can perform the [b]ghostblade[/b] spear attack.
This attack penetrates locked doors to kill enemies!

______________________________________________________________


Wait a second... did you say throw?

[h2]✵ THROWABLE WEAPONS[/h2]

I sure did. Almost every weapon can be thrown at your foes now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/4bb72d46e678e20f0b712f33d85886ebe663588f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Hold SPRINT and press the DROP button to throw your weapon.

[*] You can always throw most weapons, but if you have high stamina you will [b]deal more damage[/b].

[*] Melee weapons always deal more thrown damage than guns, but melee weapons[b] suffer durability loss[/b] when thrown.

[*] Throwing weapons subtracts large amounts of Stamina.
[/list]
Yes, you can even throw [b]land mines.[/b]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/TtFSovirqZ5Cw2d0SX/giphy.gif[/img]
______________________________________________________________



[h2]✵ Z-tag Tribute Awards[/h2]

I've been wanting a way to thank people around the project and in my life for a while now.
That's where Z-tags come in:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/c294ad208816558ce2a4f56603791d7d49756ddf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Zombies now have a small chance to drop a Z-tag when they die.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/uF3GTUoeU1ekVy1B18/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] The player can collect these items buy running into them.

[*] You can check your current Z-tag collection in Options on the Main Menu.

[*] When your turn Z-tags on you will receive small [b]gifts and abilities in game.[/b] 

[*] Collect them all and read everyone's goofy quotes!
[/list]

[h2]✵ Redesigned SCORING and RESULTS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/5d87347f83c3d1d1a07ac3c4a1d1840b43b88495.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Scoring has been completely redesigned and re-calibrated. 

[*] Trophies are given depending how well you perform.

[*] Score ranges are separate for each time and Difficulty. ( except Stigma difficulties )
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/w8ETKI64yLfPo4hHn2/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] You can review scores from the Main Menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/089ed8c411ad5f560719c9f1a14c108690353752.png[/img]

[/list]

______________________________________________________________


Players hold the [b]UP key and press ATTACK[/b] to use items now. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/bc69e814e3b2f975e6ccb98b1d23b40cfe133f19.png[/img]

The [b]cycle item key[/b] is it's own button now. There won't be accidental item switching anymore once you understand the layout.

As I said there have been so many things changed, added and tweaked. I honestly can't remember all of them. I've tried to address any bugs along the way to keep the experience true. For anyone who plays with the Keyboard and Mouse, that has been tightened up as well. If you're a vet I might recommend playing that way just for fun. 

I'll be happy to answer any questions about the new update! So please lay them on me.

So if you're interested in a future for STLD ...

notes.title: Christmas Sales and Big News Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, I hope you're keeping warm. The project is still going ... however, as is usually the case I haven't been the best with news updates.

 There's been a tight schedule lately, I have about an hour a day during the average workweek. Over the past few months, there have been major and important changes made to STLD to tighten up the system and trim out a lot of the fat. Most of it has to do with interface refining and clunky UI. But rather than a paragraph of details let's just list it out with some bullet points.

[h2]The following changes will be made with the release of STLD REDUX: Night Mist ...[/h2]
[i]( First Quarter 2020, hopefully )[/i]
[list]
[*]The game's resolution will be increased to showcase more details and visibility and make way for a less distracting User Interface.

[*]Investigate text will appear below the Player, and only while the UP key is held.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/89ded96bd5806b1211abef6e61618a7abba0294e.png[/img]

[*]The base widescreen resolution will be 800 x 450 and will adapt to your monitor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/a9147c92cd855f0e7b6c4f2d979230eea4316849.png[/img]

[*]Changes will be made to the controls to make them less funky:

[*]To use an Item you will need to hold "UP" and press "Attack"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/659eed5051be2e87e1b7afaa1e3e7acb5c201724.png[/img]

[*]The old Item use button will become the "Item Cycle" button.

[*]Double tapping the "Item Cycle" button will jump to the most useful item for the situation. ( Flash Item )

[*]Menu Interfaces will be reduced and altered with the resolution change.

[*]The Player will only trip when Stamina is empty and Health is Low 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10324027/c5ef3fbd8c0d9c9ef3ebe06760040a792060a957.png[/img]

[*]The Players speed has been reduced to accompany the size correction.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/JTmvUaU4Aprl2uEHuk/giphy.gif[/img]

[*]Scores will be retweaked to accompany the boss addition and trophy Icons will finally be added.

[*]The weapon discovery sound has been changed to something less loud and repetitive.

[h3]The Inquisitor needs the following: [/h3]
[*]Animations ( done )

[*]Base Programming ( done )

[*]Two spell sprites animated (  )

[*]about a weeks worth of bug testing (  ) 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l0i740nvJGnbYYi5Ey/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]It's no exageration to say the majority of my time these day goes into the bosses AI system and adding/debugging his navigation and attacks, it's going fine, but it isn't perfect yet.[/i]
[/list]
---------------

[h3]End of the line.[/h3]
A final weapon will be dropped upon defeating the Inquisitor, the player can use this to inflict massive damage.

Later Change : Eventually, the tutorial will be updated and simplified.

I'm aware I keep making alterations to the game, I want to take a moment and thank every single one of you wonderful ( and incredibly patient ) people who leave kind reviews for it.
Every moment I spend taking the project to completion these days is because of you. I'm wishing you all the very best, and the happiest of Holidays! 

Thanks again and Cheers!

-Pyro

P.S. You're probably hoping for a deadline on this stuff... Promising a deadline is always a bad idea but I can give a rough estimation and I will mention that once the holidays are out of the way I'll have more time to spend on it. With some luck and consistency on my part, I hope to have the final version ready by March 2020.

notes.title: Special Compendium addition Update and Sale!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, sorry for the radio silence. I've still been adding to the project, and this new feature has been in the works for quite a while. So here it is , an in-game [b]Weapon Compendium![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/e8837b33a4317319197ea3f71fa356b5d85d4db2.png[/img]

This is an unlockable feature that goes over the [b]25+ weapons[/b] in the game and how to use their special abilities to maximize your survival!

Most people don't realize the Mace has a special move that makes it [b]unbreakable[/b] while active, or that the Combat Knife has a [b]flurry attack[/b].
The Weapon Compendium covers that, along with secrets and so much more!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/3d01edf40c8d6fc5d86b157f105490e15ec6aab5.png[/img]

**** The Compendium can be unlocked with 3 tokens the player earns in-game. You can find it from either the Main Menu or the Death Screen:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/d044f4e38dfd013c1530ea168d89e46e49d673cc.png[/img]
You can find it here.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/f59dfd1e899ba7e2ed66dc99f2fadfaaa8992d62.png[/img]
Or here.

The Compendium covers Slot machine weapon rewards as well. So when you win a temporary weapon for the next round, you can read up on it first and learn all its secrets!

I'm pretty excited for this one, I really think this update will shine some light on a vastly overlooked perspective of the game, so be sure to check it out.

As far as other features go, my next big one is finishing the Inquisitors AI, and then the custom keyboard controls. I'll likely be trying to wrap these up before Steam and it's crazy summer sale but I can't make any 100% promises. 

As always I hope guys are doing well, and thanks so much for stopping by and checking the latest news with STLD! 


See ya soon,


-pyro

notes.title: Quickie announcment! Next Update news.
notes.notes:
Hey there, I've been trying to find time whenever I can to get the next update out to you guys. Players have been asking me about making some changes and tweaks so I've been doing my best to hammer some of that stuff out and simultaneously work on the Custom Controls feature, it's almost there. 

Sorry it's taking so long, programming custom controls is kind of a tedious process.
 
Unfortunately this following update might not be too exciting for veteran players of the game, as it will consist of a lot of fixes and features to make the game more approachable to new players. The Update should be ready and out of the way by next week, and it will include the following additions/changes:


[list]
    
[*] The Main Menu will be updated and newly arranged to accompany all the recent features, including the Custom Controls and the Slots minigame.. So you will be able to gamble from the first screen and not just when you die.
   
 [*] The Lemat Revolver's alternate fire feature will work a little differently. Multiple people have complained about the confusing nature of using this gun and the user [b]Drugon[/b] had a good suggestion on a way to remedy that. I'll explain how it works in the actual update.
    
[*] The Death Screen will do a better job of explaining what the Slot rewards are when you win them. And it will also attempt to tell the player that these rewards are temporary, as there has been some confusion there.

[*] There will be a 6 minute "Dry run" feature at the cost of a token. This will allow newer players to explore and investigate the level without the threat of zombies.  


[*] Throwing the rock from the second story will kill a cultist if it lands on their head. 


[*] Custom Controls, obviously being the biggest change in this update. This will make the keys customizable to whatever the player prefers.

[*] A pause button on the keyboard.

[/list]

notes.title: [ UPDATE V20 ] Achievements!! and more!
notes.notes:
Hey there! I hope everybody out there is doing well. It's finally time for another update... This time our main focus is.. you guessed it!


[h1][b]51 Achievements have been added! [/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/897537d8c253eaed2fe917760a63be2d5787c962.png[/img]

I spent a large portion of this week personally play testing and making sure all these achievements pop off when necessary, which isn't as easy or fun as it might sound. But then again this actually was fun, and it was really great to be able to dive back into work on STLD again. These were such a long time coming and I hope you guys enjoy !

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/59bb3df7c5227027069cd1a7c818df05bcd59c37.png[/img]

That's right, the game now looks a heck of a lot smoother. Thanks to some great guidance and advice from Matt Lucas at Esperware interactive, the game now performs at a better rate, the [b]camera scrolling[/b] code has been improved and redesigned and all in game weapons are slightly faster! woot. 

[b][h1] The Magic Charm is now a permanent item![/h1][/b]
I had always planned to do this but only as of late designed a way to make it work in game. The [b]Magic Charm[/b] now becomes an [b]Artifact[/b], which basically means that once you dig it up and discover it will always be in Amber's inventory!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/37ea3c4b4491328933bb58508c4e3fba64d5a61f.png[/img]

In future rounds if the player goes back to dig at that same spot where the Charm used to be you will discover a [b]brand new[/b] item I've just added in this update called the [b] Power Bar [/b]. Well 2 of them actually..

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/08158bb91903ae2831de25ba2abae2c4f3d001d5.png[/img]

[b] Power Bars are consumables that instantly give Amber 3 PWR orbs [/b]
(the things she uses to break zombie attacks and perform special attacks of her own with the melee weapons)  

As a little side not these bars [b]don't[/b] count against the play as "Aids used" when they are graded at the end of the round. Just a heads up!


[b][h1] Inventory not as cluttering as before. [/h1][/b]
Because keys discovered aren't actually usable items, they have been removed from the inventory cycle, so now there is less the player needs to look through when messing around down in the corner of the screen. Rest assured she still has the Keys and they work the same when interacting with  the environment. And, I'm going to re-add the keys in a different spot on the interface in a later update. 

[b][h1] Enemies now flash to indicate they've been damaged and show critical hit text. [/h1][/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6fIV4hYtKrr7ItgY/giphy.gif[/img]

I'm often trying to see what works or what can be tweaked to improve the visual gameplay, I really like the way the damage flash effect looks in some games ( SOTN had something similar ) but there are many others. Anyway there's been a few changes made to STLD in that regard. 

I think that's about it for now guys, I'll likely be tackling the SLOTS feature next and maybe some more inquisitor animations to get that guy ready for action. 

Have a great weekend.


-Pyro

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6fIV4hYtKrr7ItgY/giphy.gif[/img]

Have a great weekend.


-Pyro

notes.title: [ UPDATE V19 ] Tutorial, Various changes, Hiatus News. (EDITED July 20th)
notes.notes:
This Update was all over the place. It began as about 1 week of intended work but quickly grew into a multi-faceted snowballing living turd from hell.

It happens sometimes.


[h1][b]Tutorial[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/a03a088081aeba7c0d0b12af9d7681253b0fc1f5.png[/img]

The tutorial covers controls and should give the player a basic understanding of what things are going to be like. I notice when people first start playing STLD they are trying to take their time to understand a bit and investigate.. too soon do they realize the zombies are already there. The tutorial is different in that it moves at your pace for the most part.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/90552cbf3284869ff1c9ccf85f092fd18b8efcb7.png[/img]

You may feel it's a little short, but then again maybe not. I don't think I've ever heard someone actually say aloud " that tutorial wasn't long enough!" It can be replayed multiple times, and I actually recommend that if you'd like to train a bit. I saw someone do that to learn how to use flash-items. (the down button).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/3f3ae86e2d1e77ac36e50d88163f13227699945a.png[/img]

The controls are the same as always, but I've added a little bonus for players who like to play with the "WASD" setup. If you're used to playing games like CSGO or any other fps(s) on your pc then you're used to one hand resting on the [b] Mouse [/b]. Well now you can shoot, pick up weapons and drop weapons using just the mouse.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/18181399d4b9636e58680c0fe1a4f4154580bc9d.png[/img]

Also, the controls menu on the main screen has been updated so you have a bit more of a visual queue to work with before heading straight in. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/5c4dbd53bfdfa0501af924a6ca6bb0e08116c351.png[/img]

[h1][b]Weapon Interaction[/b][/h1]

There's been many complaints on the controls, mainly weapons and how you find them. I think just about every "lets play" I've seen on STLD touches on this subject. "Touches" might be a nice way of putting it.

Believe it or not I am listening. Amber no longer ever uses the [b] Investigate Button [/b] to equip a weapon. [img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3og0IPdBGqmOe6yEhO/giphy.gif[/img]


This should also completely eliminate that damned bug that occurs for players with a low frame rate. I mean the bug where you pick up certain items like the land mine or bear trap and the character never receives them.

I have a feeling this weapon change might be a bit off putting to vet players. (NEW). You can now toggle the old way back on in the options menu, if you experience issues with weapons disappearing please leave "WEAPON OVERIDE" [b]unchecked[/b] in the options menu.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/26c6dc0865cc6e285e9e6ad422ea5bc60ebfd060.png[/img]


If you get through the tutorial you'll notice the new weapon. Well more of a revival really, but with cleaned and updated animations and sprites. (and a bigger punch too). "The Goblin" (MP5 basically) will be available as a [b]slots reward[/b] in the final patch for Episode 02. Meaning you will be able to bring it into the real game for further devastation. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3og0IPLWJlkm4J9VPW/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Changes and Bug Repair[/b][/h1]


Amber will no longer stay downed for long periods of time after getting struck by a Magic Missile spell or by tripping on a trap.
This was never intended, she should pop back up after tapping sprint multiple times. ( 5-8 )

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/649525234b62958e08187d60a49b7aabc8ce534f.png[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=05b5TJ2FbVc&t=25s

[list]
 [*]Amber remarks less vocally when she gets multiple kills. Her sound files we're playing just a little too often.

[*]Getting stunned by the Priest cultists stun spell wouldn't remove the aiming cursor for the Sailfish if the player was Aiming at the time of spell impact. That should be better now.

[*]There might be new bugs with the recent changes, if you experience any, please report them to me. You will have my gratitude!
[/list] 


[h1][b] News/Hiatus [/b][/h1]

STLD is a strange beast in itself. Years ago, when I first created Episode 01, and it was known only as "Survivor: the Living Dead " I was young, depressed, and didn't really care. I didn't know what I was doing, I didn't know why I was doing it, and I still don't know how or what drove me to finishing that game. But I did.

I finally released that game on a website my dad had helped me host called RadicalEndeavors(.)com. I was going to make video games and help him sell his comic book collection all in one place. It never really happened that way though. As I said, I was depressed and unfocused but on top of that I began having severe anxiety which eventually manifested as partial blindness in my right eye. I didn't know what I was doing, I was confused , afraid , I certainly didn't believe in myself or the game. 

Not long after the website went up it began crashing from an overwhelming amount of traffic. STLD was a hit. People loved it. It was hard and buggy, but intense and rewarding. The Story was brief and grim, but left the player satisfied with Amber's vengeful body count, while also yearning for more. More content, more back story, more characters...  But I didn't care.

This was not a happy time for me, I had decided before going live with the game that it would be free, and that it would always remain that way. I didn't know how the game would perform on other peoples PCs', what if they didn't like it? What if it was a waste? What if people thought I'd just completely ripped the story right off of Night of the Living Dead? 

My family did not agree with this "free" aspect. And it became an awkward conversation point with anyone I knew. " Why would he do that? " I couldn't answer then. But I know now making it free gave me the confidence to actually finish it. I wasn't hurting anyone, whether it was good or not I wasn't ripping anybody off. It wasn't much of a reason but in the end that's what I ran with...

And now I'm here. People wanted more years ago, and I was too much of a mess to deliver. I didn't know how or where to take it from there, and I certainly didn't have the passion.... 

Years later, the passion and confidence came back.  After becoming dangerously dependent on the drugs I took for my anxiety, ( and eye) I eventually kicked them. And during my long months of recovery I clung to art and exercise like they were oxygen. 

..The place I stand these days is somewhere between poetry and irony.

For these last two years I've worked on re-building and redesigning every aspect of the game, while trying my best to stay true to it's core nature and listen to a fluctuating audience. This is easily the hardest I've ever worked on anything. Thousands upon thousands of hours of my life have been put into STLD, and I've honestly never felt more passionate about it than I do now. I've written a 10 episode story Arc with over 20 characters designed, some intended to be playable characters once developed.

Unfortunately this passion doesn't pay the bills. And even with Summer here, this games LIFETIME sales do not add up to enough to pay for 1 months rent of living in California. I don't know what you guys want, I don't know if I'm delivering on my promises or if times have changed and I just waited too long. Regardless I have to tackle real life bills and issues, because as of now STLD is not paying them. I hope it can stand on it's own as of now, and it's worth the 5 dollars to you.

I do love this game, and I love you, the followers and community. But things might be slow around here for a while.  I still would like to do a kick-starter for more episodes down the road, but as of now I don't think the following would even be strong enough to support it. 

I'm not giving up, I will be adding updates when I can, STLDs been a part of my life for a long time. I don't know where the future goes from here but I do hope we can embark on it together.

P.S.

Thanks for the endless nightmares of inspiration George. Where would I be without you?

notes.title: [ UPDATE V14 ] Polishing some edges. Cover Art Glimpse
notes.notes:
Hey there, this was a weird update. It took some time because of some certain issues the game was having. Mainly though it was the fact that I had to test the game thoroughly every time in 18 minute mode. So fine tuning or problem solving meant I had to spend 18 minutes each time confirming whether something worked or didn't. So yeah.. sorry it's been a little while.

Also the great [b]BigCjns[/b] called out a bug a few weeks ago about 18 minute mode having zombies [b]stop spawning[/b] near the end of the level ( about 15 minutes in ). I falsely thought I had fixed that bug, which I actually hadn't, so I have to apologize for that. I do believe I discovered the error in my code now and that shouldn't happen anymore, I've playtested multiple times and it seems to be ok now. So I'm sorry I hadn't actually fixed that sooner.

So what's actually changed in this update? 




[list]
    [*] [b]The Death Menu[/b] has been cleaned up and new graphics have been added. Additionally the menu has received a little music, just a brief death Hymn. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/4c738d8d7ec85ea5fd8da91003e7b6c8f3b35d87.png[/img]
    
    [*] [b]You now gain a token[/b] per 25 kills each on the death menu. So basically it works like this now, even if you die.

at 25 kills you earn a token
at 50 kills you earn a token
at 75 kills you earn a token
at 100 kills you earn a token
at 150 kills you earn a token

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/ec50a28dd329944533c8fecd7f580b88a9599800.png[/img]

[*] [b]The Survival Timer[/b] on the level has been updated. [b]New music[/b] has been added to 15 minute mark while playing [b]18 minute mode[/b]. Basically just cleaned this up too, it now flickers at important times and plays music to catch your attention and let you know how your time is progressing. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/9f32587e90ee238e5f600b428a167f28fb6b32ad.png[/img]   


[b] Some minor alterations and fixes[/b]

 [*] [b]The explosion in the Still room now kills the player[/b] in one hit if they are standing in it when that happens. This is at request of the players, this is very similar to the way the kitchen acted in Episode 01.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/73bd32ee42ffae5f5ae112c37c14602bda28b599.png[/img]   

 [*] Enemies should now properly activate when they [b]spawn out of the closet as a suprise attack.[/b] They were just standing there or walking away, this was a bug I hadn't caught at first.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/860bedfd52d597b5aea26703c2b4a3da6a43f184.png[/img]
 
  

 [*] Pressing the Down button now will always revert to the [b]Magic Charm[/b] if you have it in your inventory. This means the player can quickly react and reflect incoming spells. 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/97bf73b0d7be4995628465ac3a4eb8e3bc0d2ef9.png[/img]

    [*] Additionally some of the items wouldn't flash properly when you were standing on them, that should be all better now.
[/list] 


My apologies for not getting around to all of the bugs I have note of this update. A lot of this week wen to different art and assets. And as previously mentioned bug testing can be very time consuming, like solving a very annoying mystery , only after you solve it you have to figure out how to make it never happen again.

Anyway! Here's a glimpse of the cover for Episode 02 I've been working on. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/570ec88c7086e7ddc0feb08cc37c1668fed55b9f.png[/img]

That should be done soon, along with some other art pieces for the game. I'm sure it seems super slow around here lately. This is the hardest phase of the game for me, so please hang in there. You guys are great.

I'll do another word update soon. So if you're still interested stop by here and there, this things almost on its feet I promise!

 [b]When your health is low.... [/b] to switch quickly to the [h1] First Aid Kit [/h1]

 [b]When your health is low.... [/b] to switch quickly to the [h1] Painkillers [/h1]

[b]When you're badly infected  [/b] to switch quickly to the [h1] Antivirus [/h1]

[b]If you've planted a Remote Mine  [/b] to switch quickly to the [h1] Remote Trigger [/h1]

[b] If a Cultist is casting a spell.  [/b] to switch quickly to your [h1] Spell Reflect Charm  [/h1] ( you must have found it first )


[b]When you're badly infected  [/b] to switch quickly to the [h1] Antivirus [/h1]

notes.title: [ UPDATE V12 ] Bug Repairs ( And a little Gift )
notes.notes:
Hey there guys! You might be interested to know what this update is about.. or you might already be bored to shit with it ( it's all about perspective ).ːsteammockingː

First off I really need to thank a couple users who are helping me keep this crazy game on the right track:

[B]Vyper2040
BigCjnS
Gladiator[/B]

Thank you all for going into detail and helping me hone in by describing some of the issues you've encountered within the game. Over the last few days I've been on a hunt to track them down. You've got my gratitude, and I would always appreciate your future input or straight up opinions on things concerning STLD. Without further delay here's a list of what's been changed or repaired.

[H1][b] CHANGES [/b][/H1]

 [list]
    [*] [b] That damned stair bug is finally gone. [/b] I'm referring to the one that often occurred when the player would go downstairs and the first shot they fire would miss. I thought I had repaired this one a few weeks ago. I was quite wrong.  

[*][b] The Remote Bomb now saves when purchased in the Skeleton Key Reward Menu. [/b] **Please see the bottom to read about the gift this week.

[*][b] The Sailfish Repeater no longer disappears when you discover Lemat ammunition in the closet. [/b] I was so confused by this bug, I had to do some digging to figure out exactly what the crap was going on. Hopefully it's all better now. 

[*][b] Closet Values have been adjust so that the uncommon items appear more often.  [/b] This wasn't really a bug, hopefully it just makes the gameplay funner.

[*][b] When discovering Painkillers in the closet, you also find 3 shotgun rounds. [/b] The Painkillers item in the closet is a very common item to find the second time players open the closet, I wanted to make it a little funner and useful so now you get some first aid and a bit of [b]bang bang[/b] as well.

[*][b] Rocket Launcher has one extra rocket when playing 18 minute mode. [/b] To clarify, when you kill the Dread zombie that pops out of the closet and he drops a Rocket Launcher, it will hold 2 rockets if you are on 18 minute. Only one on 10 minute mode. ( works in both Hardcore and Normal )

[*][b] The Fire Bow now holds more Ammo. [/b] I'll list this change as simply as I can. The Bow has [b]7 Arrows[/b] when you play 10 minute mode. When you play 18 minute mode the bow now has [b]10 arrows[/b]


[*][b] The Mace Invulnerability has been extended to 7 seconds and blinks while ACTIVE [/b] The Ammo counter on the bottom left screen will blink when you activate this PWR ability, as long as it's blinking the mace should be unbreakable. Also if you hold [b]Sprint[/b] now you can still attack, if you prefer not to let your finger off that button. 

[*][b] Explosions will now damage doors and usually knock them down. [/b] Basically if something explodes too close to a door it will cause damage to it just like a zombie does.  If that door doesn't have a wooden board on it , the door will likely fall over if too close to the blast.

[*][b] Standing in the First Room when the CONTAINERS explode will cause severe damage to Amber.  [/b] When you damage the [b] Still Containers[/b] and they leak enough fumes they will explode the room. If you are in the room when this explosion occurs you get hurt very badly now.

[*][b] Traps can no longer be placed too far into the Staircase. [/b] Occasionally zombies and monsters would step over traps if you place them right into the base of the staircase ( taking 0 damage ). This should no longer be able to occur.

[*][b] The Cultists no longer get stuck on the Staircase when they are injured. [/b] You may have noticed they just stop some times on the stairs after taking damage. This shouldn't happen anymore.

[*][b] The rock item has been tinkered with a bit. [/b] Hopefully this will prevent the player from having further issues throwing the rock. (Just in case)

[/list] 

[H1][b] Where's My Present? [/b][/H1]

So besides the fact that the [b]Fire Bow now holds 10 arrows[/b] in 18 Minute Mode, you will gain a Skeleton Key from now on if you beat 10 Minute mode with the [b] Hardcore Difficulty [/b] turned on. So now there's even more incentive to playing Hardcore mode.

[h1]here's something else for you for a [b]limited time[/b][/h1]

I feel bad about the Remote Mine not saving when players have purchased it, so now that it's repaired , for a limited time you can have it and Hardcore mode again for free.  

Press [b]H[/b] on the Main Menu and you will be rewarded with both Hardcore Mode and the Remote Mine. This is going to be a for a limited time only!! so if you want these gifts for free you should do this [b]before the end of this week [/b] They should save properly this time without any nonsense so you can have them permanently if you wish to press the H key and unlock them. 

Ok that's all I've got for now, I'm gonna be back I hope near the end of the week to show you guys some more of the asset art I'm working on and give you more news.

Thank you all for staying with this project, it wouldn't be the same without you.

If something is still funky with any of these bugs , please let me know!


Cheers,


-Pyro

notes.title: [ UPDATE V11 ] Skeleton Key Rewards, Hardcore Mode.
notes.notes:
Heeey there! It's been a while since I've had some content to share with you guys,  I hope this Update fills an adequate gap. Here we go.


 [H1] SKELETON KEYS AND REWARDS ARE HERE [/H1]

 [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/b4d3913340da365ffe15519285f28f29f4e815f1.png[/img]

You can earn these keys from completing [b]18MIN mode[/b]. If you have [b]Hardcore[/b] turned on you will earn 2 keys per completion of 18Min mode. 

As pictured above you can unlock a number of items. Let's go into a bit of detail in case some of you are curious what the hell I've been doing, or what's actually new.

[list]
    
[*] [b] Repeater Magazine [/b] Grabbing this will let you start every round with an extra ammo clip for the [b]Sailfish Repeater[/b] it shows up in your inventory and can be loaded into your gun whenever you'd like.  
    
[*] [b] The Remote Mines back! [/b] 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/1c69ced6dbecf6ff850dcfdc9759f57306194206.png[/img]
With one key spent this item will always appear at the beginning of the frame for you to use whenever you require something blowed the heck up.
    
[*] [b] The Fire Bow [/b]

I may have bitten off a little more than I could chew with this one. The Fire Bow costs one key and will appear every time in the first building afterwards.
It shoots flaming arrows, the longer you hold the attack button , [b]the further the arrows flight range will be.[/b]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4FGDHCjXtQnsIbEA/giphy.gif[/img]

I will be adding a sprite later that will indicate the amount of power/range behind each level of bow pressure so don't worry.

I wanted to add a little something else with this one so after some brainstorming I came up with flaming arrow traps. Don't worry if you mess up and don't shoot the arrow far enough, if it lands on the ground it will create a [b]Flaming Trap[/b]. [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/eced0601711a958d9e19d141c3e45347afbf51a0.png[/img]
 Oh snap. This has been a long time coming. With the Body Armor purchased from the Rewards menu ( costs 1 key ) you will begin each round with a suit of armor granting you [b] 5 more Health bars[/b]. That's a lot of protection if I do say so!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/e4d6ffa4c1696c6de5d67b0352c72d87e32e78ea.png[/img]

Cheers,

-Pyro

notes.title: [ UPDATE V10 ] A Dynamic Closet & Hardcore (Beta)
notes.notes:
Hello hello. So this was an experience in programming, taking a somewhat simple closet and turning it into a monstrous twist of fate. OK I exaggerate.

Thank you all for being patient with me. I know I originally said Saturday. Please know I tried.

Here's what's new

The closet now holds random items or bad things... It can be opened multiple times when you leave it alone and come back to it later. This can be bad or good, it's a test of luck.. the odds are in the players favor though.


[h1]What's in this? Who Cares?[/h1]

You'll will [b]more than likely[/b] come across additional painkillers and alternate ammo for the revolver when you play. If you discover both of those in the same playthrough, your odds are significantly higher to discover a list of other things afterwards.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/3df7294dd6fe25e7870eec5b07a975d74ee2a8e1.png[/img]



Body armor is coming soon, [b]in fact![/b] it's already here! If you are lucky enough you'll find some in the closet, this will only last for [i]that[/i] current playthrough if discovered. But you will be able to permanently unlock it next week via the rewards screen. ( I apologize for using the word via, this is an indie game after all. )

[h1]Let's gear up[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/2311fad02adb19750485901abf71020bfcd239d5.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/75ae106be2b620fd94f602d1210a0c6dad946ef2.png[/img]

At this point I want to show off what else has been done. But like any red blooded humanoid living in the age of rampant spoilers, I tussle, we tussle.. and are forced to make choices .. do I want to know now? Or wait and discover it all myself?

I'll let you decide. 

GIFS below....

[spoiler] Ok, well now that that's over. Here's a list of what you'll encounter in this crazy closet: 


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/f30bdcafd074bf246db3e810749a8f5424b60c41.png[/img]

[list]
    [*] A Healthkit. (Low Odds)
    [*] Painkillers. (High Odds)
    [*] Lemat Alternate rounds, (High odds)
    [*] A bomb. It explodes on you, you can either kick it away, run away , or have it blow up in your face. ( Low odds )
    [*] An unlit bomb. Stick it in your inventory, throw it at things you don't like. ( Low odds )
    [*] A wooden board. Just like all the others, this reinforces doors. ( Low odds )
    [*] A cultist. That's right! Some times they like to hide inside the closet now. They might pop out occasionally just to say hi. ( Low odds )
    [*] Body Armor + 30 shotgun rounds. Jackpot! (Very low odds )
    [*] A poison cloud that you should run away from immediately. (Low odds)
    [*] A stick of [b] Black Dynamite[/b]. This explodes almost instantly after being thrown. No cultist will be fast enough to outrun it, zombies don't like it either. (Very low odds)
    [*] A dread Zombie... (Very low odds)

[b]What the hells a dread zombie?[/b]

More like the return of the dread zombie. This guys tough. He doesn't run away like the cultists do and he takes a decent beating. 

 [/list] 

[h1] Dread Zombie [/h1]

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/3og0IvzbtZ3pGRyAzS/giphy.gif [/img]

Upon killing the dread zombie you gain a rocket launcher, so it's not all bad. Use this to take out a group of zombies instantly, or an annoying cultist.. Who knows?

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUA7b4hqcY8dEigJTq/giphy.gif[/img]

That's about it for the closet for now. I'm sure it will be undergoing a little maintenance in the future.

[/spoiler]

In other news the Beta for Hardcore is available if you want to check it out and really put your abilities to the test. Maybe you just want to flex all the stars you've spent on the rewards menu while earning some more. Playing Hardcore mode earns you additional tokens. Just a heads a up, there's [b]A LOT[/b] more zombies.

[b]To activate beta Hardcore mode simply tap the "H" key while on the Main Menu, or before you're about to pick your playtime.[/b]  You can visibly tell you're going into a Hardcore challenge because the times and letters will turn bright red. Tapping H will toggle this on and off. 

[h1] Shit got real [/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/011516e68adccc8344252039c77ac69fbafea9fc.png[/img]

I want you guys to know, even if you don't plan playing hardcore at the moment, you should toggle it on and off at least one time this week. Because in the next update it will cost tokens to unlock. If you toggle it on now, it's yours as a gift forever!

I'm gonna be playtesting more to make sure everything works correctly with that, so I can take it out of beta status and forge onward with the completion of this monstrosity. 

Expect more explanations and stuff tomorrow, with Monday's Work week layout. I have a little check-list ( almost complete ) I'm trying to get through before I take Episode 02 out of Early access.. Oh happy day!

I hope you all had a great weekend, thank you so much for the positivity and feedback. I'm really trying hard to make this game as fun and unique as possible. What's amazing and is also extremely important is that you guys care, and that you stop by to see what's up and to play what's new. It keeps me going and excited to dive back in every week. Together we're seeing this thing through to completion. And even if episode 03 never gets funded you've all made this a hell of a ride. So cheers to you and that.

See you soon.

- Pyro

You have the opportunity if you'd like to take on 18 minute mode and earn more tokens if you win, or do a quickie in 10, and upgrade some stats. Don't trust these new longer time sets? [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/f29dd23a9e392d7e9c412dcd2a8178f2e396d519.png[/img]
[list]
    [*] Voice Effects added
    [*] Plays the correct animation when stealing Ambers weapons off the ground.
    [*] "Counter Attacked" potion now hurts zombies much more when dropped accidentally at his feet.

[*] Planted bomb now has an extended fuse timer, so Amber has more time to kick it back at enemies.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/564f35bf493a06b347057d5727adbe0110d23b83.png[/img]

[*] Have their own unique Health pools, The Red guy being the strongest, the Deerman second, and the Priest being the weakest in the HP department.

[*] Killing  a cultist will cause the game to send some additional zombies if the combat gets too slow in parts.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/7567241a1ff096e53d8143f54736e8221b6a14a5.png[/img]
[*] The [b]Twig Traps[/b] Cultists plant on the ground can no longer be hidden into the shovel area where the player cannot see. And additionally the Twig Traps contrast and colors have been boosted up so the player can identify the trap more quickly.

[/list] 
 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ohzdVlHwHLrtW7Q0E/giphy.gif[/img]
Step partially into the trap while unarmed and press the Attack key to burn them. ( it's been this way for a while .)


[h1] Changes with Amber and the Player [/h1]


[list]
    
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/25911dccb03a6795f392099765bfd00bfb2987e0.png[/img]
[*] [b]Door lock Icon colors have been changed.[/b] ( this was a long time coming) Hopefully this will help oldies and newbies understand at glance which is which with ease.
    
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/c17ecfc397e41c434b6220e06e6db8a76d0eba27.png[/img]
[*] [b]Contrast Boosted on the Special Clip item.[/b] Since folks seem to miss it a lot.
    
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/f5bfc9d29b8a5aef63776c2915de714e1d8d4a3f.png[/img]
[*] [b]Shovel durability raised to 30[/b] This just makes more sense, since you can't spend points in the thing, but having the shovel itself potentially last longer helps balance gameplay without overpowering anybody.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/dc8d3406a74d0f525c60977a01141f4cc2a9ea57.png[/img]
[*] [b]Ambers Stamina pool has been raised[/b] Now it takes the gauge longer to run out. And when you tap Sprint after falling your Stamina fills back much faster. I'm just trying to get this thing balanced, it seems to work fine like this.

[*] [b]Tripping into doors now causes them to crash down if you have enough momentum.[/b] I have been toying with this idea for a while, I used it to help fix the bug where Amber trips, and clips through locked doors. This will also come in handy if you're locked outside and are without a weapon. The player could potentially trip-crash their way back into the building

[*][b] More Tokens are earned in general from playing 18 minute mode, and later on special unique rewards will become earn-able only in that mode.[/b]

[/list] 


Ok! There's tons more stuff in the works, but I think that's all the news I have in me right now, I hope you guys are down with the latest changes and like the new video. I'm gonna be adding some fun stuff next week, so be ready for a Work week layout on Monday.

Good night guys,

-Pyro

notes.title: [ UPDATE V8 ] The Priest and the Sailfish
notes.notes:
Whew it's finally here! 

Hi guys! it's time for another update, and this one is just chock full of crap so I'm just gonna make it easy on myself and you and try to bullet and summarize everything that's been added or changed. Originally I wanted to get the [b]Priest[/b] out in the middle of this week, but I decided to wait until Saturday so I could finish and showcase him with the [b]New Gun![/b]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/5aa360c9ab810ef469c93c984924802a8575c444.png[/img]


[h1]Priest has been added.[/h1] 

The Priest Cultist will appear like the others do and through various means.. [b]attempt to kill you.[/b]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGcDtpoAnTCjB8uk/source.gif[/img]
Like the others he has a main attack and a defensive one. This is his main attack which is a [b]Fire potion throw[/b]

His defensive attack, which triggers when you get too close is a [b]Confusion Spell[/b]. ( which can be reflected back onto him)
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGcjVDKimqa1cHqo/source.gif[/img]


He will occasionally summon Zombies if you lock him out of the house, and will often bless the other Zombies with a [b]speed boost bonus[/b]. [img]http://i.giphy.com/xUPGcHWwvkl5OBUdUI.gif [/img]



Besides being able to reflect his Spell you can [b]Counter Attack[/b] his Potion throw by shooting him before he finishes tossing it, it will then become deadly toward Enemies. [img]http://i.giphy.com/xUPGcGjQdGdoXBAwpy.gif[/img]


ooo000o he looks pretty scary. Might want to use the [b]New Sailfish Repeater[/b] on him!


______________________________________________


[h1] [b] Sailfish Repaeater [/b] [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/64e8458dec4ca633ff5b9c97c2207d10a45b34bb.png[/img]

The painting can now be interacted with. If you can solve the puzzle you'll be rewarded with this gun. The Sailfish is a repeating rifle that has a special ability when you hold down the [b]Sprint Button[/b]. If you can time the Cursor within the blue box you will deal serious damage to Cultists and deal [b]instant head-shots[/b] to zombies. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGcgf4tNTKieOHy8/source.gif[/img]


And hey if that doesn't suit you, the [b]Dynamite sticks[/b] have also been switched out with the Remote mine. These are 3 throwable sticks of Dynamite that explode after a certain amount of time. The remote mine is gone for now but will be available again soon, it's location is basically just being moved around the map.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/xUPGctyYO0UT92NNVS/source.gif[/img]


The water tower itself has been changed slightly so now it basically pours water out after the second time the pole is struck with a bullet. Before it took about 4 shots to get it rolling but I think that was a bit counter intuitive.

Beside all that I'm still fine tuning [b]a lot[/b] of things, I'm going to record the Priests Voice effects next week and make some small changes to things I've been meaning to but other than that next week will be pretty boring, I need to work on the Item assets more , as you can probably tell I don't have a new image update with those... I just haven't had the time work on them. I won't go too quiet but if it seems a little slower around here next week please just know I'm still here and extremely invested. I'll be making tweaks and changes to the Priest as time goes on, I need to make another announcement about the final phase of the game.. because we are definitely in it now!

Happy Saturday folks!

-Pyro


On a side note for some reason the review count on this games Steam Page is dropping , it went from 14 down to 11.. I don't know why. So if you care about this game or the projects future and you haven't already please consider giving some feedback, even if it's heavy handed. I read them. People stop by and read them too.

notes.title: [ UPDATE V5 ] PWR , Secrets , More!
notes.notes:
Hi guys sorry about the delays on this one. Got a lot of little things out there, and I've finally got the Pwr aspect of Amber programmed so that's exciting, I'll explain a bit.

- [b]PWR Abilities![/b] So unique kills or killing creatively will award you with a PWR orb. Once you've aqquired 3 you can do a number of things!

With 3 PWR Orbs:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/7f3f904aa61e5352750e7fbd691bdcc3e34cc79c.png[/img]

*Break off incoming attacks by pressing the sprint key when grabbed by a zombie.

Hold shift and Press the Attack Button to execute these Melee attacks:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/7a9b395b1781fc254fac174e8766b94f2abb8f3f.png[/img]
*Shovel:  Smash , a single heavy attack that deals 10x the Shovels normal damage. This costs 3 orbs and lowers the Shovels durability by 5 points.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/51d9a8c5de479f20a7066f00636e69642637af9a.png[/img]
*Mace: Unbreakable , the Mace takes no durability loss for 6 seconds and gains additional damage permanently . ( This can be done multiple times to make the Mace extremely powerful. )  This costs 3 orbs each time.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/5e5c5d7e644b55cec41ed0a6ce9fe706b013e8f2.png[/img]
*Combat Knife:  Flurry, the character swings the knife 2.5x as fast for 5 seconds. The stun chance raises on the knife significantly during Flurry.

[b]PWR[/b] will have more uses as weapons and things are added in the future. If there is a future for STLD.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/46a6d10a1608824f59492bfaab31405f47d3a7f9.png[/img]
- [b]The Secrets screen[/b] is out! Spend a couple tokens you've earned into the Reward Menu to get some serious advantages in the game.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/3bfa48b15c93f924979efe57302d4613214156ff.png[/img]
- Weapons receive a [b]damage[/b] bonus once you've maxed them out.



- [b]S Ranks[/b] are now programmed , this means if you play exceptionally well, you will be rewarded with an even higher Grade Rank than A, and receive an extra token to improve your characters weapons.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/b664e5a0876ade1df3d950e70ca4cbc49f67efa4.png[/img]
-[b]Highest Scores[/b] are now saved and appear on the Main Menu when you go to play. Now you can set records and compare with others.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/4497b233f189efcba7df945392aa61ae378d9f5e.png[/img]
- The [b]Shotgun[/b] also known as the "Rattle Snake ", has a bleed a bonus that occurs randomly now. This was initially just to make it a little different from the shotgun on the first level,  I feel like it injects some fun into it too.

notes.title: [ UPDATE V3 ] Scoring, Combos, Grading, Reward System .
notes.notes:
Originally intended to have this one out last Friday, but it's just so damn big... And got bigger along the way. I apologize that my update projections aren't always accurate, having to design and program all of the assets of each little step tends to confuse me my with own timelines that I set up. Anyway here we are!  

Again it's late and I have not slept so I'm going to bullet point things for now and really explain tomorrow in another announcement.


- The save feature is back, so now music should stay off, screens should stay full, rewards you earn stay earned... etc

- You are now graded on the way you play. Play better get a higher Score. Get a higher a Score to Earn more Tokens. Spend Tokens to increase your ammo supply and strengthen the character.

- There is a Combo system now , so if you keep killing things you can chain up bigger combos for more points!

- The Tactics system is back and better than ever. Everything you do is noted by the Tactics system, and now you can chain Tactics together for big multiplier bonuses and really get some sick scores. ( An example of chaining  Tactics together would be getting 2 consecutive shotgun head shots in a row, to chain it even further you could do something like smashing zombies with the Crusher, or  getting some things to walk onto a Land Mine. ) Any unique kill will begin a Tactics chain, use any creative kill you can to keep that chain alive.  The bigger your chain the more gangster you look in front of your homies. ...er I mean the bigger your Score is. I'll explain it more soon.

- You can now upgrade your favorite guns with Tokens, the spending system is pretty straight forward at the moment, I will definitely be fleshing it out more so there's a little more too it than just upgrading ammo.   

- The PWR Orbs gain much more often now, with 3 Orbs Amber can break a zombie grasp. In the future these will do much more, I'll explain soon I promise. PWR Orbs are gained much like Tactics, when you kill or react creatively you gain more orbs, if you're fast enough you'll never get bit again.

- The Red Acolyte's health has been lowered. He's a bit weaker now, so there.

Ok there may be a bit more but I'll cover it tomorrow.

I'll be updating the graphics and sounds with rolling updates over the rest of the week into the weekend, my next big priority is the Tips and Secrets stuff.

Thanks guys, see you soon.


-Pyro

notes.title: [ UPDATE V1 ] +Sounds and More
notes.notes:
Hi there guys. Finally just finished the update, all said and done there's around 45 new sound effects added with this patch. 
 
 The Cultists make new noises when attacking, as opposed to the silence before, this means stuff like the Spells casted and the Bull rush attack. Environment interaction now has sound effects added as well, "the Bone Crusher" in the Sacrifice Room now how has a proper [b]SLAM[/b] impact , rather than silence... Hadriex will be hopefully pleased to know the Boop sound has returned. I can go into more detail, but there's no need at the moment. This is bitter sweet exciting for me, for the first time in years it really feels like this project is coming together. I hope there are some folks out there who still want to see that happen, and that the long silent state without updates did not permanently murder the newly thriving fan base. I'm here to stay this time. The updates will be continuous until this Episode is shambling on it's own two feet, and it wouldn't be the same without you guys to share it with. And thank you to all the ghouls lurking off in the dark quietly watching. I know there's a few, and you make my world go round.

I spent a decent amount of time trying to program the door opening sound effect, but that one is unfortunately going to have to come in the following patch.. as it is causing some weird issues and I didn't want to hold this train up any longer. Zombies still need sound effects but that will be coming soon as will all of the Cultists voice effects.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10324027/75ed7bb40f857ca68346e5fe5c2131d05f6b4d5d.png[/img]

[b]On top of the new sounds[/b] there is now an [b]Icon Key[/b] screen. Which basically just shows the meaning of all the icons you will come across during the game. I had wanted to do this, but a shout out belongs to RocketPunch! for bringing it back to my attention, so thanks. Also , locked environment locations in the game display a Lock Icon instead of a Brown Eyeball Icon.

Music is still coming, and soon. I promise. I want it integrated properly with the menus, death and reward screens. So those have to be nice and decent first.

There's lots more to come, including explosive weapons, some guns, and more hidden secrets to discover. As before I will update my work layout for the week on this ever so upcoming Monday. So please keep an eye out and drop by once in a while. 

Cheers,


-Pyro

notes.notes:
Hey there, it's update time again. A lot going on lately, just barely getting some work in on the project so I thought I'd show you guys some of what's been happening content-wise while I have a minute.

I've decided to do a video update which I'm posting to Youtube so I can showcase the weapons and level design and discuss some things. I'm hoping it will be easier than rendering out all these shitty little gif animations I've done with previous updates. ( Actually. I'll still probably be doing that for my twitter followers anyway ) To learn even more about what's been going on and how I've acquired the games new soundtrack, please read below the video.  


https://youtu.be/0bpFDAv0SFQ

[img]http://i.imgur.com/0yKI7Fs.png[/img]

Among the many jobs I've been working lately there's one that stands out to me. It was a lot of fun, a lot of work , and extremely important to the future of STLD. Again I apologize for the large gaps in between updates.  I myself am not a musician, so the task of acquiring music, and making sure it was the appropriate type for the game was looking a bit intimidating, especially with STLDs ( non existent ) budget. Thankfully my friends at Esperware totally saved my ass. With their musical compositions and my illustrations we've been working together to produce some really awesome stuff.

I had the pleasure of making this poster in trade for musical works from Esperware,  it's for their upcoming game Anathema. Which I am now plugging because it totally kicks ass and I can't wait to get my hands on it. Anathema broke its away into the Steam scene not long ago and very soon after achieved Greenlight status. The title took roots with a Castlevania-esq style of gameplay but has since then undergone a big engine revamp. The changes focus on delivering a fast paced and flexible system of gameplay suited for continuous action that is more akin to the likes of Ninja Gaiden. I was lucky enough to play a bit of the latest engine build, and all I can say is I can't wait to take the character they've designed into a boss battle. Super fun.  

If you get chance, give these guys a look. Drop by and check out their steam page, or their website here. Or give them a follow on Twitter to keep up with what's going on with the project.  

anathemagame.com

Looking forward to working together with them again in the future, thanks guys.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Quick-Fix for FullScreen and Menu Freeze issues.
notes.notes:
I've been struggling to find the issue some PC's have with the Steam Overlay interface causing the game to freeze at the main menu and when activating full screen mode. I have come up with a manual solution for players until I can pin in it down directly with Steam. Basically what you'll be doing is disabling the Steam Overlay for Survivor : The Living Dead. ( do not worry this will not affect time played, and achievement stats )

If you are experiencing this problem simply:

1. Open the Steam Client
2. In the Steam Client menu find Survivor: The Living Dead
3. Right Click Survivor: The Living Dead anywhere
4. Find "Properties" at the bottom of the small menu that appears.
5. Open the "Properties"
6. Find the Check-Box that says "Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game"
7. Un-check that box, close the "Properties" and play the game.



I apologize for not recognizing this issue before the game was released for Early Access, I am currently a 1 person team and have difficulty testing on many different windows platforms.

I intend to address this entirely to give all users the ability to play and use the Steam Interface. Thank you for the comments and patience.

Please don't hesitate to contact me with questions or problems directly 
Pyroklasticgames@gmail.com
